sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00 in what they describe as a local derby. This matchup sees the league leaders take on a team near the bottom of the table, and Sandbach will be looking to avenge a cup penalty defeat to Alsager from the previous week. Sandbach then travel away to face Allscott Heath on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, seeking to maintain their strong position despite a recent loss.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second in the table on 20 points, make their first-ever trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, with supporters advised that there is no parking at Theatre of Jockeys and alternative car parks are available nearby. Allscott Heath host Crewe on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend what they claim will be five consecutive wins. Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Telford Town to their Ideal Building Systems Stadium on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, with adult admission at £6 and concessions at £3. The derby between Wednesfield Community and Wolverhampton Casuals takes place on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, described as an important fixture for both clubs. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Eccleshall face AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Foley Meir host Bilston Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Market Drayton Town play New Mills on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Shawbury United visit Barnton on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Midweek action sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45. The following Saturday, 10 October, sees Bilston Town host Crewe at 15:00, Alsager Town travel to Shawbury United at 15:00, Barnton host Dawley Town at 15:00, Market Drayton Town face Widnes Town at 15:00, Sandbach United visit Cheadle Heath Nomads at 15:00, Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community at 15:00, and Telford Town travel to New Mills at 15:00.
